descriptionEn: Why is Nepal's flag the only non-rectangular national flag in the world?
description: संसारमा लगभग २०० देश छन्, तर आयताकार नभएको झण्डा एउटा मात्र छ — हाम्रो नेपालको! किन? यसका दुई त्रिकोण, चन्द्रमा र सूर्यको अर्थ के हो?

facts.en: Nepal has the only non-rectangular national flag; Switzerland's and Vatican City's are square but still four-sided.
facts.ne: नेपालको झण्डा संसारको एक मात्र आयताकार नभएको राष्ट्रिय झण्डा हो। स्विट्जरल्याण्ड र भ्याटिकनको झण्डा वर्गाकार भए पनि चार कुने नै हुन्।

facts.en: The flag began as two separate triangular pennants, joined in the 19th century.
facts.ne: सुरुमा यी दुई छुट्टाछुट्टै त्रिकोण ध्वजा थिए, जुन उन्नाइसौँ शताब्दीमा जोडिए।

facts.en: The moon and sun are said to express the wish that Nepal lasts as long as they do; crimson is the rhododendron's colour and the blue border stands for peace.
facts.ne: चन्द्रमा र सूर्यले नेपाल सूर्य-चन्द्रमा रहुन्जेल रहोस् भन्ने कामना जनाउँछन् भनिन्छ; रातो रङ लालीगुराँसको र निलो किनाराले शान्तिलाई जनाउँछ।

facts.en: The geometric construction of the flag is written into the constitution; it was officially adopted on 1 Poush 2019 BS (16 Dec 1962).
facts.ne: झण्डा कसरी बनाउने भन्ने गणितीय विधि संविधानमै लेखिएको छ; यो वि.सं. २०१९ पुस १ गते आधिकारिक रूपमा अपनाइएको थियो।

sources.title: Hayden Rue – Flag of Nepal
Flags of the World – Nepal

titleNe: के नेपाल भविष्यमा छ? नेपाली पात्रो किन ५७ वर्ष अगाडि?
descriptionEn: Why is the Nepali calendar (Bikram Sambat) 57 years ahead of the Gregorian calendar? The story starts in 57 BCE.
description: संसार 2026 मा, नेपाल २०८३ मा! विक्रम संवत् किन ५७ वर्ष अगाडि छ? र जनवरीदेखि चैतसम्म किन ५६ वर्ष मात्र?

facts.en: The era starts in 57 BCE, so Bikram Sambat runs 57 years ahead of the Gregorian calendar.
facts.ne: विक्रम संवत् इसापूर्व ५७ बाट गनिन्छ, त्यसैले यो इस्वी संवत्भन्दा ५७ वर्ष अगाडि हुन्छ।

facts.en: Because the new year starts in Baisakh (mid-April), the gap is only 56 years from January to Chaitra.
facts.ne: नयाँ वर्ष वैशाखमा सुरु हुने भएकाले जनवरीदेखि चैतसम्म फरक ५६ वर्ष मात्र हुन्छ।

facts.en: The link to King Vikramaditya of Ujjain defeating the Shakas is tradition; it appears only from the 9th century CE.
facts.ne: उज्जैनका राजा विक्रमादित्यले शकहरूलाई हराएर यो संवत् चलाएको भनिन्छ — यो परम्परा हो, यसको उल्लेख नवौँ शताब्दीपछि मात्र भेटिन्छ।

facts.en: Nepal is the only country that uses Bikram Sambat as its official calendar.
facts.ne: विक्रम संवत्लाई सरकारी पात्रोको रूपमा चलाउने संसारकै एक मात्र देश नेपाल हो।

sources.title: Vikram Samvat (Wikipedia mirror)
SEAsia – Why Nepal is 57 years ahead
eKantipur – Bikram or Gregorian?

titleNe: नेपाली ब्रान्डले रेड बुललाई कसरी टक्कर दियो?
descriptionEn: How did a Nepali energy drink take on Red Bull? The 2019 import ban, local factories and a marketing blitz, explained in 60 seconds.
description: ५ वर्षअघि कसैले नाम नसुनेको नेपाली एनर्जी ड्रिंक, आज रेड बुललाई टक्कर! २०१९ को आयात प्रतिबन्धले कसरी नयाँ ब्रान्डलाई मौका दियो?

facts.en: Nepal imported about NRs 2.39 billion of energy drinks in 2017/18; in June 2019 the government banned imports of caffeinated energy drinks to curb the trade deficit (imports, not consumption).
facts.ne: नेपालले २०१८/१९ मा करिब रु. २.३९ अर्बका एनर्जी ड्रिंक आयात गरेको थियो; जुन २०१९ मा व्यापार घाटा घटाउन क्याफिनयुक्त एनर्जी ड्रिंकको आयात रोकियो (पिउन होइन, आयात मात्र)।

facts.en: Agro Thai Foods Pvt Ltd, Xtreme's maker, was registered in December 2019 and produces in Lalitpur.
facts.ne: एक्स्ट्रिम बनाउने एग्रो थाई फुड्स प्रा.लि. डिसेम्बर २०१९ मा दर्ता भयो र ललितपुरमा उत्पादन गर्छ।

facts.en: Red Bull's local production began in Nawalpur in December 2023, making Nepal the fourth country producing the gold can.
facts.ne: रेड बुलको स्थानीय उत्पादन डिसेम्बर २०२३ देखि नवलपुरमा सुरु भयो — गोल्ड क्यान बनाउने संसारको चौथो देश नेपाल।

facts.en: Xtreme sells a 330 ml can and sponsors 7 of the 8 NPL Season 3 team jerseys. Health professionals advise moderation because of the sugar content.
facts.ne: एक्स्ट्रिमको क्यान ३३० ml छ र NPL सिजन ३ का ८ मध्ये ७ टिमको जर्सीमा एक्स्ट्रिम छ। चिनी धेरै हुने भएकाले विज्ञहरू कम पिउन सल्लाह दिन्छन्।

descriptionEn: Why do Nepalis worship dogs during Tihar? Yama's messengers, the Mahabharata story of Yudhishthira's loyal dog, and how Kukur Tihar reached Mexico.
description: तिहारमा हामी कुकुरलाई देवताझैँ पुज्छौँ, तर किन? कुकुर यमराजका दूत, युधिष्ठिरको कुकुर जो स्वयं धर्मराज यम निस्किए, र मेक्सिकोसम्म पुगेको हाम्रो परम्परा, ४० सेकेन्डमै!

facts.en: Kukur Tihar is the second day of Tihar; in Hindu belief dogs are messengers and guardians of Yama's realm.
facts.ne: कुकुर तिहार तिहारको दोस्रो दिन हो। हिन्दू मान्यतामा कुकुर यमराजका दूत र यमलोकका पहरेदार मानिन्छन्।

facts.en: In the Mahabharata, Yudhishthira refuses heaven without his dog, which turns out to be Yama/Dharma himself.
facts.ne: महाभारतमा युधिष्ठिरले आफ्नो कुकुरबिना स्वर्ग जान मानेनन्, र त्यो कुकुर स्वयं धर्मराज यम निस्किए।

facts.en: Pet, stray and police dogs receive tika, marigold garlands and food.
facts.ne: यो दिन घरपालुवा, सडकका र प्रहरीका कुकुरलाई टीका, सयपत्रीको माला र मिठो खाना दिइन्छ।

facts.en: Mexico has adopted the Kukur Tihar tradition.
facts.ne: मेक्सिकोले पनि कुकुर तिहारको परम्परा अपनाएको छ।

titleEn: Was the Kathmandu Valley Once a Lake?
titleNe: काठमाडौं उपत्यका पहिले ताल थियो? मञ्जुश्रीको कथा vs विज्ञान
descriptionEn: Was the Kathmandu Valley once a lake? The Manjushree legend, the Chobhar gorge, the Kalimati clay, and why Kathmandu shakes more in earthquakes.
description: काठमाडौंमा बस्नुहुन्छ? तपाईंको घर कुनै बेला पानीमुनि थियो! मञ्जुश्रीले चोभारको डाँडा काटेको किंवदन्ती, र विज्ञानले पनि चोभार नै भन्छ। कालीमाटी, प्राचीन हात्तीका जीवाश्म, र भूकम्पसँगको सम्बन्ध, एक मिनेटमै!

facts.en: A lake formed in the valley more than a million years ago and drained through the Chobhar gorge.
facts.ne: काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा १० लाख वर्षभन्दा पहिले ताल बनेको थियो, र पानी चोभार गल्छीबाट बग्यो।

facts.en: One study finds lake clay in the central basin until about 12,000 years ago (Sakai et al., 2016).
facts.ne: एक अध्ययन अनुसार उपत्यकाको बीच भागमा करिब १२ हजार वर्ष अघिसम्म तालको माटो जम्दै थियो।

facts.en: Lake clay (Kalimati Formation) is 200–300 m thick in the centre; fossils of ancient elephants, deer and pigs have been found.
facts.ne: उपत्यकाको बीचमा २००–३०० मिटरसम्म बाक्लो तालको कालो माटो (कालीमाटी) छ, र प्राचीन हात्तीका जीवाश्म भेटिएका छन्।

facts.en: Soft lake sediments amplify earthquake shaking (shown in 2015 Gorkha aftershock records).
facts.ne: कमलो तालको माटोले भूकम्पको कम्पन बढाउँछ, त्यसैले काठमाडौं झन् बढी हल्लिन्छ।

titleNe: मरेपछि के हुन्छ? विज्ञान र गरुड पुराणको जवाफ
descriptionEn: What happens after death? What scientists found in dying brains, the hair-and-nails myth, and what the Garuda Purana says, explained in Nepali in under a minute.
description: मरेपछि के हुन्छ? मुटु रोकिएपछि दिमागमा के हुन्छ? के अन्तिम घडीसम्म पनि आवाज सुनिन्छ? र गरुड पुराण अनुसार आत्मा १३ दिन कहाँ रहन्छ?

facts.en: Brain cells begin dying within minutes without oxygen.
facts.ne: अक्सिजन नपुगेपछि केही मिनेटमै दिमागका कोषहरू मर्न थाल्छन्।

facts.en: University of Michigan (PNAS, 2023): 2 of 4 dying patients showed a gamma-wave surge; the authors say it does not prove conscious experience.
facts.ne: मिशिगन विश्वविद्यालयको २०२३ को अध्ययनमा ४ मध्ये २ बिरामीको दिमागमा मृत्युको बेला अचानक तीव्र गामा तरंग देखियो — यसले सचेत अनुभव प्रमाणित गर्दैन।

facts.en: UBC (Scientific Reports, 2020): some unresponsive dying patients' brains still responded to sound hours before death.
facts.ne: UBC को २०२० को अध्ययनमा केही बिरामीको दिमागले मृत्युको केही घण्टा अघिसम्म आवाजमा प्रतिक्रिया दियो।

facts.en: Hair and nails don't grow after death — skin retracts. The Garuda Purana says the soul stays near family for 13 days (a belief, not a fact).
facts.ne: मरेपछि कपाल र नङ बढ्दैनन्; छाला सुकेर खुम्चिँदा बढेजस्तो देखिन्छ मात्र। गरुड पुराण अनुसार आत्मा १३ दिन परिवार वरिपरि रहन्छ भनिन्छ (मान्यता)।

titleEn: Why Do We Celebrate Kag Tihar? | Tihar Explained
descriptionEn: Why do Nepalis worship crows on the first day of Tihar? Crows are believed to be messengers of Yamraj, the god of death, so families leave rice and sweets on their rooftops at dawn to keep grief away for the year. Kag Tihar also starts Yampanchak, the five days of Tihar, remembered as the time Yamraj visited his sister Yamuna. And a plot twist: science says crows can remember human faces for years!
description: तिहारको पहिलो दिन कागलाई किन पूजा गरिन्छ? यमराजका messenger, यमपञ्चकको कथा, र एउटा plot twist: काग मान्छेको अनुहार वर्षौँसम्म याद गर्छ!

facts.en: Kag Tihar is the first day of Tihar (Yamapanchak), Kartik Krishna Trayodashi.
facts.ne: काग तिहार तिहार (यमपञ्चक) को पहिलो दिन हो — कात्तिक कृष्ण त्रयोदशी।

facts.en: Crows are believed to be Yama's messengers; food is placed on rooftops to ward off grief (belief).
facts.ne: काग यमराजका दूत मानिन्छ; दुःख नआओस् भनेर बिहानै छतमा भात, मिठाई र अन्न राखिन्छ (मान्यता)।

facts.en: Tihar is said to remember Yama visiting his sister Yamuna — the story behind Bhai Tika.
facts.ne: यमराज बहिनी यमुनाकहाँ पाहुना गएको सम्झनामा तिहार मनाइन्छ भनिन्छ।

facts.en: University of Washington mask experiments: crows scolded a 'dangerous' face for years and taught other crows.
facts.ne: वाशिङ्टन विश्वविद्यालयको अध्ययनमा कागले 'खतरनाक' मुखौटा लगाउने मान्छेलाई वर्षौँसम्म चिने र अरू कागलाई पनि सिकाए।

titleNe: देउसी भैलो किन खेलिन्छ? "बलिराजाले पठाएका" को Real Story
description: हरेक तिहार हामी घर-घरमा भन्छौं "बलिराजाले पठाएका", तर बलिराजा को हुन्? दानवीर राजा बलि, वामन अवतार र तीन पाइला जमिनको कथा, जुम्लाको लोककथा, र "भैलो" शब्दको अर्थ। 👆

facts.en: King Bali was a generous daitya king who conquered even the heavens. Vishnu came as Vamana, a small Brahmin boy, and asked for three steps of land.

Vamana grew huge and covered the earth and the sky in two steps; for the third step Bali offered his own head. pleased by his generosity, Vishnu granted Bali a boon to return to the earth once a year, during Tihar. Deusi singers say they come "sent by Bali".
another story links Deusi to a "Baliraja" of Jumla in the Karnali region. There is no official historical evidence for it.

titleEn: भाइटीका किन मनाइन्छ? चेलीले माइतीलाई किन टीका लगाइदिन्छन्? (Why do we celebrate Bhai Tika?)
descriptionEn:
चेलीले माइतीलाई किन टीका लगाइदिन्छन्? किराँत लोककथामा बहिनी जमुनाले ३ शर्त राखेर यमराजलाई रोकिन्, अनि मखमली फूल कहिल्यै ओइलाएन! यमुनाको कथा, तेलको घेरा, मखमलीको माला र सप्तरंगी टीकाको अर्थ। 👆
Why do sisters put tika on their brothers on Bhai Tika? A Kirat folk legend of a sister who outsmarted Yamraj with three conditions, the Yama–Yamuna belief, and what the oil circle, makhamali garland and seven-colour tika mean, in under 60 seconds.

facts.en: When King Bali Hang fell gravely ill, Yamaraj came to take him. His sister Jamuna asked Yamaraj to wait until her puja was done. She set conditions. Yamaraj could not take her brother until the tika on his forehead faded, the water she sprinkled dried, and the makhamali flowers wilted. Makhamali (globe amaranth) does not wilt quickly, so Yamaraj had to give up and her brother got a long life.
On this day Yamaraj visited his sister Yamuna's home and ate there. A brother who visits his sister and eats from her hands on this day is said to be freed from sin.
Sisters pour a line of oil (and water) around their brothers. It is believed to be a boundary against evil and death.
The makhamali garland stands for long life, because the flower stays fresh for a long time.

titleEn: सप्तरंगी टीकाको ७ रङ = ७ ग्रह? 🪔 कुन रङको के अर्थ | Meaning of the 7 Colours of Bhai Tika #shorts
descriptionEn:
भाइटीकामा लगाइने सात रङको अर्थ के हो? ज्योतिषीय मान्यताअनुसार हरेक रङ एउटा ग्रहको: रातो सूर्य, सेतो चन्द्र र शुक्र, कलेजी मंगल, पहेंलो बृहस्पति, हरियो बुध, निलो शनि। अनि plot twist: शास्त्रमा पाँच रङ मात्र, नेवार किजा पूजामा दुई रङ मात्र! 👆
What does each colour of the saptarangi (seven-colour) Bhai Tika mean? The astrological belief links each colour to a planet, plus the Yama–Yamuna story and the five-colour debate, in under a minute.

facts.en: Saptarangi means "seven-coloured". Sisters put this multi-colour tika on their brothers on Bhai Tika, the last day of Tihar.
Religious belief: on this day Yamuna put tika on her brother Yamaraj; sisters pray to Yamaraj for their brothers' long life.
Astrology (jyotish) explanation, given by Santosh Vashishtha, member-secretary of the International Panchang Determination Committee: each colour stands for one of the seven main planets.

- Red = Sun (Surya). White = Moon (Chandra) and Venus (Shukra). Liver-brown / maroon (कलेजी) = Mars (Mangal). Yellow = Jupiter (Brihaspati). Green = Mercury (Budh). Blue = Saturn (Shani).
- Rahu and Ketu, the other two of the nine grahas, are left out because they are said to give poor results.
- Symbolic meanings commonly given: red for strength and courage, white for peace and purity, yellow for knowledge, green for growth and progress, blue for calm and patience.
- Together the seven colours are said to wish the brother love, long life, health, happiness, peace, prosperity and success.

titleEn: नेपालको समय किन ५:४५? ⏰🇳🇵 संसारभन्दा १५ मिनेट फरक! | Why Nepal Time Is UTC+5:45 #shorts
descriptionEn:
नेपालको समय संसारका अरू देशभन्दा १५ मिनेट फरक किन छ? गौरीशंकर हिमाल हुँदै जाने ८६°१५′ पूर्व देशान्तर रेखा, भारतभन्दा १५ मिनेट अगाडि, र पूरै देशले ४५ मिनेटको समय चलाउने संसारको एक मात्र देश। 👆
Why is Nepal's time zone UTC+5:45, fifteen minutes off from the rest of the world? It is measured from the meridian through Mount Gaurishankar, and Nepal is the only country on a 45-minute offset.

facts.en:
Nepal Standard Time (NPT) is UTC+5:45. Nepal does not use daylight saving time.
Almost every country's time zone is a whole hour or a half hour from UTC; a 45-minute offset is very rare.

Nepal's time is based on the meridian 86°15′ East, which passes through the peak of Gaurishankar (7,134 m), a Himalayan mountain about 100 km north-east of Kathmandu. 86°15′ East works out to exactly 5 hours 45 minutes ahead of UTC (each 15° of longitude is one hour).

Before the change, Nepal used the same time as India (UTC+5:30). Today Nepal is 15 minutes ahead of India. Sources disagree on the year Nepal moved its clocks 15 minutes ahead: some give 1986 (2042 BS), others 1956. The video does not state a year.
Only three time zones in the world use a 45-minute offset: Nepal (UTC+5:45), New Zealand's Chatham Islands (UTC+12:45), and an unofficial zone around Eucla in Western Australia (UTC+8:45).

titleEn: यदि नेपालमा समुद्र भएको भए? 🌊🇳🇵 | What If Nepal Had a Sea? #shorts
descriptionEn:
नेपालमा समुद्र भएको भए कस्तो हुन्थ्यो? दसैंमा पानीजहाजको टिकट, पोखरामा सर्फिङ, गैंडा बिचमा! अनि नेपालमा साँच्चै डल्फिन छ भन्ने थाहा थियो? तर के तपाईंलाई थाहा छ, नेपालमा साँच्चै समुद्र थियो? सगरमाथाको टुप्पोमा भेटिने समुद्री जीवका अवशेष र कालीगण्डकीको शालिग्राम त्यसैको प्रमाण हुन्। 
What if landlocked Nepal had a sea? It once did: the Himalaya rose from the floor of the ancient Tethys Ocean, which is why sea fossils sit on top of Mount Everest.

facts.en: Nepal is a landlocked country; it has no coastline.
Nepal has dolphins: the endangered Ganges River dolphin (Nepali: सुँस) lives in the Karnali, Sapta Koshi and Narayani rivers. A 2015 study estimated only 37–42 dolphins left in Nepal.
The Tethys Ocean once lay between the Indian plate and Asia. India began colliding with Asia about 50–60 million years ago, and the old sea floor was pushed up to form the Himalaya.

The rocks at the top of Mount Everest (from about 8,600 m to the 8,849 m summit) are limestones and other sedimentary rocks of the Tethys Ocean, and contain fossils of sea creatures such as trilobites.
Shaligrams from the Kali Gandaki river are fossils of ammonites, extinct sea animals. Religious belief: Hindus worship shaligram as a form of Lord Vishnu.

titleEn: छठ पर्व किन मनाइन्छ? राजा प्रियव्रत र छठी मैयाको कथा | Why Is Chhath Celebrated?
description: छठ पर्व किन मनाइन्छ? देवी भागवत पुराणको कथा: विवाह गर्न नचाहने राजा प्रियव्रत, कश्यप ऋषिको पुत्रेष्टि यज्ञ, बाह्र वर्षपछि जन्मेको सुनजस्तो तर मृत बालक, अनि आकाशबाट आएर बालकलाई जीवन दिने षष्ठी देवी, अर्थात् छठी मैया! न मूर्ति, न मन्दिर, न पुजारी, अनि जनकपुरकी छोरी सीतासँगको सम्बन्ध।
descriptionEn: Why is Chhath celebrated? In the Devi Bhagavata Purana, King Priyavrat's long-awaited son was born golden but lifeless, until the goddess Shashthi came down in a crystal chariot and brought him back to life; she is worshipped as Chhathi Maiya in a festival with a 36-hour waterless fast, no priest, no idol and no temple.

facts.en: Chhath is a four-day Hindu festival dedicated to the Sun God, Surya.
During Chhath, devotees keep a fast of about 36 hours without even drinking water.
Chhath needs no priest, because every devotee performs their own worship.
Religious belief: in the Devi Bhagavata Purana, King Priyavrat, son of Svayambhuva Manu, was devoted to austerities and did not want to marry.
Religious belief: at Brahma's request, Priyavrat married Malini, but for a long time they had no child.
Religious belief: the sage Kashyap performed a putreshti yajna (a fire ritual for a son) for the king, and Queen Malini became pregnant.
Religious belief: after twelve years the queen gave birth to a son who was the colour of gold but born without life.
Religious belief: the king carried his son to the cremation ground and was ready to give up his own life.
Religious belief: a crystal-white chariot came down from the sky carrying the goddess Devasena, who took the child on her lap and brought him back to life.
Religious belief: the goddess said she was the sixth part of Prakriti and was therefore named Shashthi.
Religious belief: the goddess Shashthi is worshipped at Chhath as Chhathi Maiya, the protector of children.
The name Chhath comes from "Shashthi", the Sanskrit word for sixth.
Devotees offer arghya to the setting sun on the third evening and to the rising sun on the fourth morning.
Chhath worship uses no idol and no temple; offerings such as thekuwa, sugarcane and fruit are carried in bamboo baskets.
Religious belief: according to Mithila tradition, Sita, the daughter of Janakpur, also observed the Chhath vrat.
Today the ponds of Janakpur are among the main places where Chhath is celebrated.
